text:
Omar: quick heads-up — ACME Models reached out about bringing their 'LlamaX' variant into our marketplace. they want wide redistribution rights and a permissive commercial clause.
Jess: thanks — do we have their upstream license file? need to confirm compatibility with our redistrib policy.
Raj: ping ACME for the CLA and export classification. large model weights may trigger EAR restrictions depending on origin. cc @Jess @Sara
Omar: they sent a short license blob in the email. pasting the key sentence: "redistribute and sublicense without attribution" — that's pretty open.
Sara: that phrasing worries me for auditability. we usually require an attribution + no-relicensing clause. also need model provenance & training data summary before public listing.
Ben: Ops question — if we accept redistribution, does that change the packaging? we typically only host quantized variants; partners want raw fp32 weights hosted for enterprise customers.
Jess: legal first: Raj, can we allow hosting raw weights behind enterprise-only gating? or is that the same as redistribution?
Raj: hosting raw weights for download is redistribution. gating reduces exposure but doesn't change legal classification. we'd need explicit export checks and an approved EULA amendment.
Omar: ACME is asking about co-branded launch and a joint blog. they'd like our marketplace listing to include their logo and a joint press quote.
Sara: timeline? marketing wants at least 2 weeks for coordinated announcement and security QA sign-off.
Omar: ACME proposed a soft-launch next month. they've offered a 30-day review window for any changes.
marketplace-bot: reminder: please attach license and training-data-summary files to the partnership tracker: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-872
Jess: Raj + Sara, can you draft a minimal EULA overlay that permits distribution only to enterprise customers and adds attribution + training-data disclosure? I can loop in ACME.
Raj: will draft. need to confirm export classification (ECCN) — ACME needs to provide origin and third-party components list.
Ben: ops note — if we host raw weights for enterprise, we'll require infra isolation (dedicated S3 buckets & restricted download URLs). estimate ~3 days to set up after legal sign-off.
Omar: great. I'll ask ACME for the CLA + ECCN + training-data summary and propose gating for enterprise-only hosting. cc'ing their contact in the email.
Sara: also request a security attestation & quantization readiness note. we prefer partners to supply 8-bit/4-bit quantized checkpoints to avoid fp32 hosting.
Omar: noted. ACME said they're open to providing quantized checkpoints but wanted to keep raw weights for a limited set of customers.
Jess: ok, action items: Omar collects docs from ACME; Raj drafts EULA overlay + export checklist; Ben preps infra spec; Sara prepares launch checklist for marketing/security. we'll reconvene next Wed.
Omar: thanks — I'll update PART-872 with current status after I get their docs.
marketplace-bot: PART-872 updated by Omar: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PART-872 :new: "ACME LlamaX onboarding - docs requested"
